title: 第13章 皇族试炼第14章 星炎试炼上层
lines: 排水渠残口塌了一半，泥水从裂缝里灌下去。
洛晖拖着绮雯钻进低矮渠道，肩膀撞上湿滑石壁，旧皮甲擦出一串碎屑。绮雯右腕黑纹爬到小臂，蓝火压在腕骨上，黑星火每往上窜一寸，就被烧回半寸。
“你现在放手，能跑得更快。”绮雯抓住渠壁，指甲刮下一层青苔。
洛晖把她往前一拽。
“你欠我的真相还没还完，想死也得排队。”
“带着暗教少主，铁卫会给你扣异教同谋。”
“他们扣帽子熟练，废墟镇卖帽子的都没他们勤快。”
头顶石缝落下灰土。
外面铁卫封锁线压近，黑钢靴踏过墓园石板。机械星纹鹰从破彩窗上方掠过，鹰腹投下细密黑纹，扫过祭坛残壁。
传声管插在教堂外墙。
“所有参与献祭者就地锁拿。所有黑星器物封存。废墟教堂列入铁卫清剿区。”
长夏没有进教堂。
命令已经把整座外环套住。
洛晖停在渠道转角，把封印钉拓印片塞进旧矿坑货单空白格。掌心蓝火一压，洛沉二字、半截坐标、那行小字全被烙进纸背。
绮雯靠着墙喘了两下，抬手按住心口。
“你没拔走断钉。”
“拔了会炸外环。”洛晖把拓印片收进内袋，“废墟镇穷归穷，房子炸了还得自己修，没人报销。”
“你爹的线索就在那枚钉子上。”
“所以带拓印。真相要查，人也得活。”
绮雯抓着墙的手顿住半息。
前方旧矿坑排水渠分成三条。左侧通向铁卫巡逻道，右侧通向塌陷墓园，中间是一条只容一人弯腰钻过的废水洞。洛晖抬脚踢开洞口腐木，先把绮雯塞进去，再回身抹掉地面血迹。
机械鹰落在渠口。
鹰眼黑纹扫入洞中。
洛晖取出赤金尾戒，往左侧水道一丢。尾戒撞上石壁，赤金残频顺着水流飘开。
机械鹰立刻偏转，带着两队铁卫冲向左侧。
洛晖钻进中间废水洞。
“奥格兄弟，死后就业挺稳定。”
绮雯在前面低声道：“你跟死人也这么贫？”
“活人欠债，死人帮忙。世道就这样。”
两人从废水洞爬出时，天色已经发白。星纹学院侧门开着一条缝，两名学院守卫抬着伤员转运箱等在门后。
显曜站在门内，深蓝长袍下摆沾着雨水，手中权杖压住侧门星纹。
洛晖把绮雯推给守卫。
“旧实验室隔离间，别让铁卫摸到。”
显曜抬手，守卫立刻盖上转运箱。箱盖内侧星纹亮起，把绮雯身上的暗星反噬压成一团暗紫光。
绮雯隔着箱缝看向洛晖。
“王血之门开启时，黑星火也会被牵动。”
洛晖敲了敲箱盖。
“醒着就写清楚，别当谜语人。你们暗教培训是不是只教半句话？”
箱盖合上，被推入学院旧廊。
显曜接过洛晖递来的货单。封印钉拓印一亮，显曜胸前长袍下的破损徽章也亮了一下。他抬手按住徽章，指节压得发白。
洛晖盯住他的手。
content_en:
The remaining part of the drainage channel collapsed in half, and muddy water poured in from the cracks.
Luo Hui dragged Qiwen into the low channel, his shoulder hit the slippery stone wall, and the old leather armor scraped out a string of debris. The black lines on Qiwen's right wrist crawled to her forearm, and the blue fire pressed on the wrist bone. Every inch the black star fire went up, it was burned back half an inch.
"If you let go now, you can run faster." Qiwen grabbed the wall of the canal and scraped off a layer of moss with her fingernails.
Luo Hui pulled her forward.
"The truth you owe me hasn't been paid yet. You have to wait in line even if you want to die."
"Take the young master of the secret sect with you, and the Iron Guard will detain you as the accomplice of the heretic sect."
"They are skilled at putting on hats. The hat sellers in Ruins Town are not as diligent as they are."
Dust fell from the cracks in the rocks overhead.
The iron guard blockade outside was closing in, and black steel boots stepped on the stone slabs of the cemetery. The mechanical star-patterned eagle flew over the broken colored window, casting fine black streaks on its belly, sweeping across the remaining walls of the altar.
The sound tube is inserted into the outer wall of the church.
"All those who participated in the sacrifice were locked up on the spot. All Black Star artifacts were sealed. The ruined church was included in the Iron Guard clearing area."
Chang Xia did not enter the church.
The order has covered the entire outer ring.
Luo Hui stopped at the corner of the channel and stuffed the sealing nail rubbing into the blank space of the old mine manifest. With a press of blue fire in the palm of his hand, the word "Luo Chen", half of the coordinates, and the line of small characters were all burned into the back of the paper.
Qiwen leaned against the wall and gasped twice, then raised her hand to hold her heart.
"You didn't pull out the broken nail."
"If you pull it out, it will blow up the outer ring." Luo Hui put the rubbings into his inner pocket. "The poor in Ruin Town are poor. If the house is blown up, you have to repair it yourself. No one will reimburse you."
"The clue to your father is on that nail."
"So bring rubbings. The truth must be found out, and people must live."
Qiwen's hand holding the wall paused for half a breath.
The old mine drainage channel ahead is divided into three. The left side leads to the Iron Guard Patrol Road, the right side leads to the Collapsed Cemetery, and in the middle is a wastewater hole that only one person can bend down to drill through. Luo Hui raised his foot and kicked open the rotten wood at the entrance of the hole, stuffed Qiwen inside first, then turned around and wiped away the blood on the ground.
The mechanical eagle landed at the mouth of the canal.
The eagle's eyes scanned the black pattern into the hole.
Luo Hui took out the red gold tail ring and threw it into the water channel on the left. The tail ring hit the stone wall, and the red gold fragments floated away along the current.
The mechanical eagle immediately deflected and rushed to the left with two teams of iron guards.
Luo Hui got into the wastewater hole in the middle.
"Brother Ogg, his employment will be quite stable after his death."
Qiwen whispered from the front: "Are you as poor as a dead person?"
"The living owe debts, and the dead help. That's the way of the world."
When the two climbed out of the wastewater hole, the sky had turned white. The side door of Star Pattern Academy was open a crack, and two academy guards were waiting behind the door carrying a wounded transport box.
Xian Yao stood inside the door, the hem of his dark blue robe stained with rainwater, holding the scepter in his hand against the star pattern on the side door.
Luo Hui pushed Qiwen to the guard.
"The old laboratory isolation room, don't let the iron guards touch it."
Xian Yao raised his hand, and the guard immediately closed the transfer box. The star pattern on the inside of the box lid lit up, turning the dark stars on Qiwen's body into a ball of dark purple light.
Qiwen looked at Luo Hui through the gap in the box.
"When the King's Blood Gate opens, Black Star Fire will also be affected."
Luo Hui knocked on the lid of the box.
"Write clearly when you're awake, don't be a Riddler. Do you only teach half a sentence in your secret training?"
The lid of the box was closed and pushed into the old corridor of the college.
Xian Yao took the bill of goods handed over by Luo Hui. The rubbing of the seal nail lit up, and the damaged badge under the robe on Xian Yao's chest also lit up. He raised his hand and pressed the badge, his knuckles turning white from the pressure.
Luo Hui stared at his hand.
